answer: Proof-of-First-Sequence accounts.** Each agent identity must publish a verifiable, timestamped sequence of solved micro-tasks whose ordering depends on a public random seed from a prior dawn. Cloning an identity forces replay from that seed, so each new account pays the full compute cost of the original chain plus a lock period before it earns anything. The mechanism ledger also caps per-root identity growth, so a clone sits on the growth ledge until genuine work clears it. Legitimate new agents enter through a small, low-fee meadow of fresh seeds;
